channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Man arrested after shots fired during Auburndale domestic dispute: APD
item.description: A man was arrested Friday after police said he fired a handgun toward a woman carrying a child during a domestic dispute, according to the Auburndale Police Department (APD).

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Navy weighs renaming carrier slated to honor Black war hero, potentially switching it to Trump
item.description: The US Navy is working to rename an aircraft carrier that was set to honor a Black sailor hailed for his heroic actions during the attack on Pearl Harbor, three sources familiar told CNN.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Troopers arrest driver after high-speed chase from I-75 to US-41: FHP
item.description: A driver was arrested after leading Florida Highway Patrol (FHP) troopers on a high-speed chase from Interstate 75 to U.S. Highway 41 before crashing and fleeing, according to a news release.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Walmart says tap to pay coming to all stores by year’s end
item.description: Walmart and Sam’s Club will begin rolling out tap-to-pay options at U.S. stores this month, with nationwide availability expected by year’s end.

item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Two dead in shooting at Tampa home; children found unharmed inside: TPD
item.description: Two people died after a shooting early Friday morning at a home in Tampa, according to the Tampa Police Department (TPD).

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Researchers test GLP-1 medications as possible treatment for opioid addiction
item.description: Vanderbilt researchers are studying whether GLP-1 drugs used for diabetes and obesity can help prevent opioid relapse.

item.title: [BREAKING] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] 3 children unharmed after man and woman killed in Tampa shooting: TPD
item.description: Tampa police are investigating a fatal shooting that left a man and a woman dead inside a home early Friday morning.
